manifest.name: dsh-branch-tree
manifest.description: Turn a DeepSeek Harness session into a folder: fork it into independent branches (full copy, compressed memory, or opening only) and browse them as a tree in the left workspace column.
manifest.author: Yige Bao (YB313)

readme.text:
> Treat a session as a folder: fork one conversation into independent branches and browse them as a real tree in the left workspace column.
>
> 把会话当文件夹：母会话是可展开的文件夹，分支作为缩进子行挂在下面，直接在左侧工作区里浏览。

[English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文)

`v1.3.1` · MIT · DeepSeek Harness plugin (web client) · `client.js` only, no build step

---

`dsh-branch-tree` turns the left workspace session list into a tree. A **master session becomes an expandable folder row**, and every **branch hangs underneath it as an indented, collapsible child row** — the relationship is visible without opening another panel.

When you create a branch you choose how much memory it inherits:

| Mode | Fork point | What the branch inherits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Full copy** (`full`) — default | the master's **last real exchange** | the **entire conversation up to that point**, copied verbatim into the branch session |
| **Summary** (`inherit`) | an **empty** session | a **compressed digest** of the whole master so far, written into the branch as its own first message — no raw history travels |
| **Opening only** (`opening`) | the end of the master's **first turn** | only the original request, no later chatter |

The default is a verbatim copy, because a branch is meant to **keep trying things**: a summary is lossy and drops exactly the details that make a branch useful — an approach you already ruled out, a spec spelled out once, the exact wording of a constraint.

How the three modes actually behave:

- **Fork point** — the host's own injected blocks (runtime context, skill catalog, time context, memory preamble) are **not** conversation and are filtered out, so the cut lands on the last reply the assistant actually gave.
- **Empty-fork guard** — the host can silently "succeed" with a branch that copied 0 events. The plugin reads the child's inherited event count, retries once without an explicit boundary, and if the branch is still empty it marks the row `emptyFork` instead of pretending it worked.
- **Summary mode is non-polluting** — the digest is requested in a throwaway scratch session, never in the master, so the master's own conversation stays clean. The digest is posted into the branch as a seed message carrying `<!-- dsh-branch-tree:seed ... -->`.
- **Summary fallback** — if the model times out or answers without the digest sections, the plugin writes a **mechanical digest** (per-turn clipped transcript, ≤12k chars) instead. A branch is never silently left empty.
- Later edits in the master are **never** pushed into the branch: it is a fully independent session from the moment it is created.

- **No conversation merging.** Dragging one session onto another only re-parents the row (and may create a sub-workspace folder when the host supports `workspaces.create`). Two conversations are never concatenated, summarised together, or merged into one log. There is no merge dialog and no merge mode.
- **No live link to the master.** Editing the master later does not sync anything into an existing branch.
- **No copies of md files.** Each branch reads the shared md files **live** — edit the master's requirements and every branch sees the new version on its next read.

DSH loads plugins as profile packages. Pick one of:

```bash

readme.section: from a local checkout (what this repo is developed against)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-branch-tree

readme.section: from a GitHub tag tarball (no git binary needed)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/YB313/dsh-branch-tree/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.1.tar.gz
```

Then restart the web GUI (or refresh the page) and open the left workspace column.

Uninstall:bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-branch-tree
```

readme.section: from a GitHub tag tarball (no git binary needed)
readme.text:
> Not published to npm — the GitHub tarball and local paths are the supported routes for now.
>
> Verified against the `dsh` developer preview. The host is still moving: if a client seat is renamed or throws, the plugin **falls back to the shipped session list** instead of breaking the workspace (see the takeover flag below).

1. Create a branch from a session: open the session row's context menu → **＋ New branch…** (or **＋ Sub-branch…** on a branch), name it, pick one of the three inherit modes, **Create**.
2. Click a folder row to expand or collapse its branches.
3. Drag a session onto a folder row to re-parent it, or onto a workspace header to move it there. Dragging never merges content.
4. Use the **Branches** panel for search, per-branch task status, rename, archive/unarchive, “remove from tree”, and diagnostics.
5. Branch output goes to `制图/<master>/<branch>/`.

The tree takes over the shipped sidebar session entry point. If that seat ever throws, the plugin sets `dsh.branch-tree.takeover` to `off` and leaves the native list alone — you can flip that key back to `on` in localStorage to retry.

Everything lives under `localStorage` keys prefixed `dsh.branch-tree.` (tree shape, collapse state, active-session hint, per-branch task status, branch-count visibility, archived/hidden markers). Clearing them resets the view without touching any session data.

- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) with a web-capable profile
- Shared host client packages (declared in `dsh.client.inject`):
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files`

The host half (`index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behaviour lives in the **client** module (`client.js`), loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`.

```bash
node --check client.js   # syntax
node test/smoke.mjs      # smoke test, zero dependencies
```

Both run in CI on every push (`.github/workflows/smoke.yml`).

---

`dsh-branch-tree` 把左侧工作区的会话列表变成一棵树：**母会话是可展开的文件夹行**，**每个分支是缩进、可折叠的子行**——不用另开面板就能看清从属关系。

创建分支时可选三种记忆模式：

| 模式 | 分叉点 | 分支继承到什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **全景继承**（`full`）— 默认 | 母会话**最后一次真实对话**处 | 到该点为止的**全部对话**，逐字复制进分支会话 |
| **压缩继承**（`inherit`） | **空会话** | 母会话到目前为止的**压缩摘要**，作为分支自己的第一条消息写入（原始历史一条都不带） |
| **开头继承**（`opening`） | 母会话**第一轮**结束处 | 只继承最初的需求消息，不含之后的对话 |

默认给全景，因为分支的意义就是**接着试**：摘要是有损的，丢掉的恰好是让分支有用的那些细节——已经否决的方案、只说过一次的需求、约束的原话。

三种模式的实际行为：

- **分叉点**：宿主注入的块（运行上下文、技能目录、时间上下文、记忆前置说明）不算对话，判轮次时一律过滤，所以切口落在助手**真正说过的最后一句回复**上。
- **空壳检测**：宿主有可能「成功」建出一个一条事件都没复制的分支。插件会读子会话的继承事件数，为 0 就先不带边界重 fork 一次；仍然为 0 就在行上标 `emptyFork`，不装作成功。
- **压缩继承不污染母会话**：摘要在一次性的临时 scratch 会话里生成，母会话自己不会被插入提示语。摘要作为种子消息写进分支，带 `<!-- dsh-branch-tree:seed ... -->` 标记。
- **压缩兜底**：模型超时、或答得不含摘要小节时，自动退回**机械摘要**（逐轮截断的对话记录，≤12k 字），分支不会被静默留空。
- 母会话后续的修改**永远**不会推给分支——分支从创建那一刻起就是完全独立的会话。

- **不合并对话。** 把一个会话拖到另一个会话上只是改变树结构（重挂载；宿主支持 `workspaces.create` 时还可能建子工作区目录）。两个会话的对话内容不会被拼接、共同摘要或合并成一份日志——没有合并对话框，也没有合并模式。
- **不与母会话保持联动。** 母会话之后的编辑不会同步进已存在的分支。
- **不复制 md 文件。** 每个分支都**实时读取**同一批 md：母会话改了需求，分支下次读取就生效。

挑一种：

```bash

readme.section: 本地 checkout（开发时用的就是这条）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-branch-tree

readme.section: GitHub tag 的 tarball（不需要本机 git）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/YB313/dsh-branch-tree/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.1.tar.gz
```

装完重启 web GUI（或刷新页面），再看左侧工作区。

卸载：bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-branch-tree
```

> 暂未发布到 npm——GitHub tarball 与本地路径是目前支持的两条路。
>
> 已在 `dsh` 开发者预览版下验证。宿主仍在变动——若某个客户端挂载点被改名或抛异常，插件会**自动退回原生会话列表**，不会搞坏工作区（见下方 takeover 开关）。

1. 在会话行的右键菜单里点 **＋ 派生分支…**（分支行上是 **＋ 子分支…**），起名、选继承模式、**创建**。
2. 点文件夹行展开/折叠它的分支。
3. 把会话拖到文件夹行上即重挂载，拖到工作区标题即移过去。拖拽不合并任何对话内容。
4. **分支树**面板里可以搜索、看每个分支的任务状态、重命名、归档/取消归档、「移出树」、以及诊断。
5. 分支产物落在 `制图/<母会话>/<分支>/`。

树接管了原生的侧边栏会话入口。若宿主挂载点抛出异常，插件会把 `dsh.branch-tree.takeover` 置为 `off`，让原生列表继续工作——你可以在 localStorage 里把它改回 `on` 重试。
全部存放在以 `dsh.branch-tree.` 为前缀的 `localStorage` 键里（树结构、折叠状态、当前会话提示、分支任务状态、分支计数显隐、归档/隐藏标记）。清掉它们只会重置视图，不会动任何会话数据。

- DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`），profile 需支持 web
- 宿主共享客户端包（已声明在 `dsh.client.inject`）：
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`
  - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files`

宿主半部（`index.js`）刻意留空——所有行为都在**客户端**模块（`client.js`）里，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载。

```bash
node --check client.js   # 语法
node test/smoke.mjs      # 冒烟测试，零依赖
```

CI 会在每次 push 时跑这两条（`.github/workflows/smoke.yml`）。
